article.title: In defense of abolition
article.author: Tempest Collective POC Caucus
article.content: T he Tempest Collective POC caucus invites you to a national Zoom panel and discussion on defending abolition. The event will take place this Saturday, October 24th, 2026 at 2 pm ET/1 pm CT/12 pm MT/11 am PT. You can register for the event here . Share the event flyer here . Opinions expressed in signed articles do not necessarily represent the views of the editors or the Tempest Collective. For more information, see “ About Tempest Collective .” Featured Image credit: Andrew Ratto , Fibonacci Blue ; modified by Tempest. The post In defense of abolition appeared first on Tempest .
